title: Common Basin Boundaries in a Transfer-Operator System
statement: For the transfer-operator system in the regime $6<B\leq16$, with fixed points $u_{-r_*},u_0,u_{r_*}$, is the basin of $u_0$ the common boundary of the basins of $u_{-r_*}$ and $u_{r_*}$?
